meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析 GitHub 仓库中所有开放的 Issue 和 PR，为每个项目生成一份带证据链接的报告，并保存到本地文件夹。它只读不写，不会在 GitHub 上留下任何评论或操作。
howto.when: 当你说出“triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs”或“github triage”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我 triage 这个仓库的所有 Issue。
say.note: Claude 会开始分析所有开放的 Issue。

say.text: triage PRs，看看有哪些待处理的合并请求。
say.note: Claude 会分析所有开放的 PR。

say.text: 对当前仓库做一次 github triage。
say.note: Claude 会同时分析 Issue 和 PR。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes all open GitHub Issues and PRs, generates evidence-backed reports for each item, and saves them to a local folder. It is read-only and never comments, merges, or closes anything on GitHub.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', or 'github triage'.

say_en.text: Triage all issues in this repository.
say_en.note: Claude will start analyzing all open issues.

say_en.text: Triage PRs, check pending pull requests.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze all open PRs.

say_en.text: Run a github triage on the current repo.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze both issues and PRs.
